items.briefing:
Quest Apartment Hotels has confirmed a customer data breach caused by a vulnerability in a third-party system, meaning guest personal information may have been exposed. If you've stayed at a Quest property, monitor your accounts for unusual activity. Separately, Asia Pacific leaders are calling for stronger scam defences, and security experts are reminding businesses that employee awareness alone isn't enough — organisations need solid technical controls in place to protect against threats.

**Practical tip:** If you receive any unexpected communication claiming to be from Quest Hotels, don't click links — contact Quest directly through their official website.
